items.item: A feature's matter can be set as dots on a ball that turns, the far side dim, with grains in orbit round it
items.evidence: src/lib/face/feature.ts, channels.ts; orb.test.ts 'the matter is set on a ball...', 'it is gathered into dots...', 'the far side is dimmer...', 'part of the rim goes into orbit...', 'with no rows a feature is filled as it always was'

items.item: What a globe has turned is kept and added to, not read off the clock, so a change of speed never jumps it
items.evidence: src/lib/face/particles.ts; orb.test.ts 'turning it moves its dots, and a whole turn brings them back', 'a change of speed never jumps it...'

items.item: run.pace rises with each tool call that starts or ends, harder for a failed one, each push with a strength of its own, and dies away
run.effort is the reasoning effort the run was asked for, least 0 to most 1, the middle where none was
items.evidence: work.ts effortShare; lib/theorem/generation.ts requestedEffort; orb.test.ts 'an effort level is where it lies...'; read once at the run's start, operations.ts watchFace, operations.test.ts 'a run keeps the effort it was sent with...'. A model's own default effort is not read

items.item: Tool calls are counted from the running message's parts, and the effort read from the conversation's setting
items.evidence: src/lib/face/operations.ts watchFace, toolFactsOf; operations.test.ts 'a turn's finished tools are counted, failures apart'; src/lib/theorem/runtime.tsx. Not seen in a live run

items.item: A run at work gives Theo the orb, held until the run rests; a run that asks is not at work, and the orb is back when it goes on
items.evidence: engine.ts setLiveness, reactions.ts work-orb, book.ts orb; orb.test.ts 'a run at work gives the face the orb...', 'it is never left out by chance', 'a run that stops to ask...'; evidence/theo-orb/run.png

items.item: The orb turns faster and is stirred more with the pace of tool calls
items.evidence: orb.test.ts 'tool calls make it turn faster and stir it...'; evidence/theo-orb/run.png (frames 4 and 5)

items.item: The orb is larger the more effort was asked for, and stays inside the visor
items.evidence: orb.test.ts 'the harder the run was asked to think, the larger it is'; evidence/theo-orb/efforts.png

items.item: The new events do not come between events a rule waits for in order
items.evidence: engine.ts setLiveness; orb.test.ts 'finishing straight after a failed tool is still relief...'; face.test.ts 'finishing straight after a failure is relief; finishing clean is not'

items.item: With motion reduced the orb does not turn, and still shows what holds for the whole run: its size and its shape
items.evidence: engine.ts pose; signals.ts steady, player.ts follow; orb.test.ts 'with motion reduced it does not turn, and still shows what holds for the whole run...'; evidence/theo-orb/reduced-motion.png (re-taken: the largest size, still)

items.item: A face that starts while a run is at work takes up the orb
items.evidence: src/components/face/driver.ts start; evidence/theo-orb/in-shell.png, phone.png (the story mounted, then the run set to work)

items.item: A globe can lose its shape: bulged into a lump, its dots frayed, some grains strayed, its orbits wavering
items.evidence: src/lib/face/feature.ts, channels.ts loose; orb.test.ts 'loosened, it is no longer a ball...'

items.item: run.context is how full the conversation is past 400,000 tokens, up to the model's window, from the usage the server last reported
items.evidence: work.ts contextShare, COMPOSED_UNTIL; operations.ts contextOf; orb.test.ts 'a conversation is as composed as ever up to 400,000 tokens...'; operations.test.ts 'the context is the newest usage the server reported...'. The usage part's shape is read from the server's source, not from a live stream

items.item: The orb loses its shape as the conversation fills, and stays inside the visor at its largest, busiest and loosest
items.evidence: book.ts orb; orb.test.ts 'the fuller the conversation is past 400,000 tokens, the less it keeps its shape...'; evidence/theo-orb/context.png

items.item: Where Theo has its plate, the plate draws in to a ball under the orb's dots and opens again after; matter outside the ball is ink on a light page
items.evidence: components/face/plate.ts (plateOf, offPlate, PlateMotion), Face.ball() in lib/face/engine.ts, the two draws in components/face/luma.ts, the per-grain choice in components/face/painter.ts; plate.test.ts (10 tests), 'the face says where its ball is and how large, only while it is one' in orb.test.ts; evidence/theo-orb/plate.png
